test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In the word VIBGYOR, which of the following two consecutive letters have the least difference between them in terms of letters of the English alphabet?
solution:
This question is based on the positional value of alphabets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77f669040fd1a63117b5e11a29cf705dcca089554991ff7303328044b71b7ad5.png] 

♦ Difference between any two letters in terms of letters of the English alphabet = Difference between the positional value of alphabets - 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c458821b05a4e4008b02b08719dca8e58ccecb05dfefe844e57469d242396663.png] 

• Number of alphabets between V and I = 13 - 1 = 12

• Number of alphabets between I and B = 7 - 1 = 6

• Number of alphabets between B and G = 5 - 1 = 4

• Number of alphabets between G and Y = 18 - 1 = 17

• Number of alphabets between Y and O = 10 - 1 = 9

• Number of alphabets between O and R = **3 - 1 = 2**

Thus, O and R have the least number of letters between them.

Hence, **'option 3' **is the correct answer.
